mechanism: Belarusian commitment gives the attack on the corridor a second axis from the east, so the cavalry screen can no longer be reinforced from one direction
closing the corridor removes the only land route into the Baltic States and pushes the whole onward movement onto the air and sea legs
losing the sea ports throws the tonnage the air leg cannot carry back onto Polish rail
a successful strike on a reception node stops onward movement while the node is repaired and the corridor is re-secured
a reception slip is a closure slip: the brigades cannot be validated until they have moved
a demonstrative detonation puts every Allied government's own risk calculus above the collective decision and is the single event most able to break the consensus
